title: ENFORCEMENT DECREE OF THE ACT ON MANAGEMENT OF FIREFIGHTING EQUIPMENT
full_text:
Article 41 (Procedure for Designation of Centers and Business Establishments) (1) A person who intends to be designated as fire equipment maintenance center pursuant to Article 36 (1) of the Act (hereinafter referred to as “Center”) shall submit a written application for designation and attached documents to the Fire Commissioner of the National Fire Agency, as prescribed by Ordinance of the Ministry of the Interior and Safety.
  (2) Where a person applied for designation as the center pursuant to paragraph (1) is deemed to satisfy the requirements under Article 39, the Fire Commissioner of the National Fire Agency shall designate the applicant as a Center and issue a written designation of fire equipment maintenance center, as prescribed by Ordinance of the Ministry of the Interior and Safety.
  (3) A person who intends to be designated as a fire engine maintenance business establishment under Article 36 (3) of the Act (hereinafter referred to as "business establishment") shall submit a written application for designation and attached documents to the Mayor/Do Governor, as prescribed by Ordinance of the Ministry of the Interior and Safety. <Newly Inserted on May 15, 2023>
  (4) Where a person who applied for designation of a business establishment pursuant to paragraph (3) is deemed to satisfy the requirements determined and publicly notified by the Fire Commissioner of the National Fire Agency pursuant to Article 36 (3) of the Act, the Mayor/Do Governor shall designate the person as a business establishment and issue a written designation of a fire engine maintenance business establishment prescribed by Ordinance of the Ministry of the Interior and Safety. <Newly Inserted on May 15, 2023>
  [Title Amended on May 15, 2023]
